settings.hero_body: The film is picked. The blanket is ready. Give your favorite night in eight colorful supporting characters, with the full companion set together beside you.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_body: Eight companions for the corner where your favorite evenings happen.
settings.moods_body: All eight companions come in the set; nobody misses the opening scene.
settings.personality_title: Give the night-in corner some character.
settings.personality_body: Set the crew along the sofa back or on a nearby shelf, then settle into your usual spot. They stay part of the room when the credits finish.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: Give the night-in corner some character.
